chains.trait: Blowhole nasal valve with sphincter control
links: Warm shallow seas (F10) demand submerged tool manipulation
Dense atmosphere (F6) increases dissolved O2 capacity
Sphincter valve seals airway during extended dives

skill.effect: breathe underwater for 10 turns, -20% movement penalty

chains.weakness: Valve seals fail in high-sediment water, causing choking

journal.en: They turned their own lungs into docking ports for living machinery.

plausibility.summary: Remove ‘warm shallow seas (F10) increase dissolved O2’—warm water lowers O2 solubility (Henry’s law); attribute 10-turn submergence to cetacean-like dive reflex + symbiotic crustacean gill gear from lore, with episodic blowhole ventilation.
fixes: Remove ‘warm shallow seas (F10) increase dissolved O2’—warm water lowers O2 solubility (Henry’s law); attribute 10-turn submergence to cetacean-like dive reflex + symbiotic crustacean gill gear from lore, with episodic blowhole ventilation.

analogues.organism: Odontocete nasal plug and blowhole locomotion; phocid/spinner dolphin dive apnea
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: High alkalinity (F10) fosters calcified shell architecture
Silent optical communication avoids acoustic predators
Synchronized dermal flashes transmit tactical commands

skill.effect: transmit tactical commands in darkness, 15m radius

chains.weakness: Light pollution in bright zones washes out signals; causes disorientation

journal.en: They built a network that thinks in pulses, not words.

plausibility.summary: Limit tactical range to ~15 m in turbid reef water; use species-specific luciferin and shuttered chromatophores so neighbors don’t broadcast to pelagic predators; calcified architecture from F10 is fine for reef builders, not for the signal tissue itself.
fixes: Limit tactical range to ~15 m in turbid reef water; use species-specific luciferin and shuttered chromatophores so neighbors don’t broadcast to pelagic predators; calcified architecture from F10 is fine for reef builders, not for the signal tissue itself.

analogues.organism: Hawaiian bobtail squid *Euprymna scolopes*–*Vibrio fischeri* counter-illumination; reef cardinalfish and deep-sea lanternfish species-specific bioluminescence
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

relations.note: Tool Breeders engineer bio-architecture in shallow reefs; Sail People exploit wind currents for pelagic cruising, competing for similar carbonate-rich waters.
Blind Folk use narrowband banshee screams for sonar in high-reverb caves; Tool Breeders use bioluminescent signaling networks that would blind/disorient Blind Folk if they surfaced.
